payload.reason: The evidence provides detailed descriptions of the inference models built to estimate socioeconomic status (SES) using various data sources and methodologies.

claims.text: The inference model for estimating socioeconomic status (SES) combines data from socioeconomic census data, crawled profession information, and expert annotated Google Street View images of users' home locations.
The model utilizes advanced semantic analysis of tweets to discriminate between individuals of different income levels.
The methodology includes a two-way classification problem to separate users into lower and higher SES classes based on income distributions.
